pr_title: Sms 187 b javascript changes to prevent sending and display tooltips and unverif

comments.body:
This might be better off as a separate (new) context, doesn't really fit in with all the sms campaign stuff. 
Up for team debate.
Make sure you update this to match what's in the c# backend PR.
@david-connell Also change the file name to match please

Use `’` or `\u2019` for quotation marks in copy. 
https://cmds.campmon.com/#/writing/punctuation

Errr do you have eslint and prettier extensions installed on your vscode? 

Else or otherwise you can run `yarn lint --fix` in the `/srcfrontend` directory.
This looks messy. I'll revisit this later.

`use` prefix is usually reserved for react hooks. 
Can you use another prefix here? `Is` or `Has` etc. for booleans. 
Something like `isTooltipEnabled` `setIsTooltipEnabled`

Probably don't need logging and the whole try-catch block here, but I guess it doesn't hurt. 
Keep in mind that `logEx` send logs to one of our monitoring services so in this case - not very helpful either.
Should we enable the next button on `NotApplicable` status?
